item.title: Scottish Government awards £500k to support Fringe's digital work - Midlothian View
item.description: The funding aims to contribute to the development of the Fringe's new website, among other projects.

item.title: Preston Lodge pupil wins East Lothian Council Young Musician of the Year - Midlothian View
item.description: An S4 pupil from Preston Lodge High School has been crowned East Lothian Council Young Musician of the Year 2026.

item.title: Mark Williams Foundation announces powerhouse line-up of business mentors - Midlothian View
item.description: The Mark Williams Foundation has unveiled an exceptional line-up of business leaders for its Entrepreneurship Apprenticeship Programme.

item.title: Midlothian councillors prefer luxury housing to industrial units - Midlothian View
item.description: A landowner has won his appeal over plans to build six new country homes on land which housed industrial units.

item.title: Mould discovered on children's cancer ward at Edinburgh hospital - Midlothian View
item.description: An investigation is underway after mould was discovered on bathroom walls in a children's cancer ward in Edinburgh.

item.title: Teaching union opposes Midlothian's online learning plans - Midlothian View
item.description: The digital campus aims to offer senior pupils the chance to take part in lessons online rather than having to travel to another school campus.

item.title: Ninety-six homes agreed despite bridge omission concern - Midlothian View
item.description: Belfast-based property developer The Mayfair Group has won approval for the major development on land adjacent to Sprouston Burn at Newtown St Boswells.

item.title: It doesn’t have to be this way - Midlothian View
item.description: This View has been written by Daniel Coleman, Scottish Labour candidate for Midlothian South, Tweeddale and Lauderdale.

item.title: Hibs set to unveil training ground expansion plans - Midlothian View
item.description: Hibernian Football Club is set to unveil its plans to expand its East Lothian training grounds.

item.title: Residents lose battle against development on their doorstep - Midlothian View
item.description: Residents in an over-55s housing development in Melrose have failed in an attempt to curtail a new homes complex on their doorstep.

item.title: Opposition push for community meetings falls on casting vote - Midlothian View
item.description: A bid by West Lothian’s opposition group to restore meetings in local public venues has been defeated by a Conservative casting vote.

item.title: Time-lines plea on EV charging opportunities - Midlothian View
item.description: Time-lines are needed as to when Borders’ residents will gain access to better EV charging opportunities.

item.title: Penicuik and Dalkeith both aim to be the UK Town of Culture 2028 - Midlothian View
item.description: Two Midlothian towns are set to battle each other for a place in the running to be named the UK Town of Culture 2028.

item.title: Two arrests for shoplifing incidents across Midlothian and Edinburgh - Midlothian View
item.description: Officers investigating a spate of shoplifting incidents have arrested two men.

item.title: Midlothian’s David Sharp targets more success at PDC Players Championship 7 & 8 - Midlothian View
item.description: Sharp heads into the events in excellent form after producing an outstanding run to the quarter-finals at Players Championship 6.
